notes.title: Deployment is coming April 10, 2018
notes.content:
Hi there, Time Travel fans!

Thanks for your kind attention to Time Lock VR.
We gained a lot of feedback and it was priceless to us since we continue discovering new game genres.

There's something special we crafted this time.

Deployment is a highly polished, detailed and attractive game with unique art style.  

Go and check this out:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/755980/Deployment/

The game offers a competitive gameplay you can play with friends.
You can play with up to 10 friends and share the experience together.

Deployment is an Online Top Down Shooter with simple, fun and exciting gameplay.
We want to continue our gameplay experiments so we invite you to join. 
Leave your feedback on the game page. We will be glad to hear your thoughts over the concept.

The hits the store on April 10, 2018.

notes.title: TimeLock VR in stores on August 9th!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29786261/a7144487ab5d061221717ed590e54563b18ce096.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi, friends[/b]


We are so pleased to announce [b]TimeLock VR[/b] will be available in stores on Aug, 9th.

We've been working hard over the game and hope you'll have a nice, smooth and pleasant experience playing it.

We are thankful to everyone who have supported us all the time. The game itself has got a little concept improve: we have focused more on time travelling mechanics and switching between timelines to solve the quests. We're sure this is a really cool feature for Escape the room games.

However, we want to hear your feedback and want to see more activity over the title. We would be happy to see [b]TimeLock VR[/b] in your wishlists or see you following the title.

We have created a topic on Steam Discussion where you can leave your feedback or ask anything you want to us:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/673450/discussions/0/1471966894870431479/

It'll be very cool to see your impressions about the game there.
We had a lot of fun making this game.
